bucket_seam.evidence: lib/config.py:14 defines S3_BUCKET once, from the process environment (BD_S3_BUCKET, default opal-data-bd). Every one of the 42 importers binds that one name (D_03.composition_artifacts.py:77 and D_04.client_portal_summary.py:83 import it as BUCKET) and uses it for every get_object, list, put_object and copy in the same process, so reads and writes are bound to one bucket per process. A script cannot send one output to another bucket without editing the script: the only switch is the environment variable, which moves every read and every write of that process together. Writes that bypass the seam are not in the 42: D_00f.advisor_nna_canonical.py:87 hard-codes S3_BUCKET = 'opal-data-bd' and writes platinum/firm/advisor_nna_canonical.json. Searching the gold directories for bucket literals returns only the bd default, that D_00f literal, and opal-data-assets / opal-data-inf / opal-data-schwab literals in B_00 and lib/schwab_* (none of them a served-class writer).
